specification.objective: Add a GitHub Actions CI workflow for Prisma and reorganize its documentation into a polished, concise README with a dedicated usage guide.

requirements.statement: GitHub Actions runs the plugin syntax check and complete Node test suite for pushes and pull requests targeting main, and supports manual dispatch.
The README acts as a concise project landing page, retains the cover, shows CI status, and links to focused usage documentation.
Detailed installation, usage, compatibility, limitations, and distribution guidance is organized in docs/usage.md and does not reference missing project files.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The workflow YAML parses and explicitly runs node --check desktop/plugin.js and node --experimental-vm-modules --test tests/plugin.test.mjs on push/PR to main and manual dispatch.
README preserves an accessible relative cover-image link, contains the workflow badge, concise feature/install/test sections, and links to docs/usage.md.
The dedicated guide retains relevant usage and technical notes, and all referenced install commands/files exist or are accurately labeled.

invariants.statement: The workflow uses the existing Node test setup and adds no dependencies or runtime plugin changes.
Documentation remains in English and existing plugin behavior and asset bytes are unchanged.

forbidden_states.statement: CI depends on an absent package manifest, package installation, or external secrets.
README or guide points to a nonexistent installer or package manifest.

inputs.statement: Existing Node syntax check and tests/plugin.test.mjs test command.

outputs.statement: A GitHub Actions CI workflow for plugin syntax and tests.
A concise README and a detailed docs/usage.md user guide.

failure_semantics.statement: Invalid workflow YAML or failed local test gates block delivery.
Broken README image or guide links and inaccurate installation instructions block delivery.
